Hi Alex / Priya —

Great to meet earlier — quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps for the 3-week POC we discussed: 

1) Success criteria (what Finlytics will measure):
   - Reduce query latency for analyst queries >= 50% on representative workloads
   - Achieve embedding relevance score >= 0.72 on your labeled sample set (20 queries)
   - Maintain data isolation and SOC2-compatible logging for the trial period

2) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 0 (this week): infra connectivity + data ingestion of a 10k-row sample
   - Week 1: baseline runs + tuning (batching/quantization guidance from Redwood)
   - Week 2: extended tests + edge-case prompts + cost profiling

3) Timeline & owners:
   - Redwood infra onboarding: Connor (internal) + Dev (technical onboarding) — target Fri 6/19
   - Data handoff & ingestion: Priya / Finlytics + Connor — target Mon 6/22
   - Evaluation & weekly status: Marissa — weekly on Wednesdays (recap email)

4) Next immediate actions:
   - I attached a one-page POC plan and an SOW draft for your review (redwood-poc-plan.pdf, sow-draft.docx).
   - Can you confirm Priya will be the primary technical contact and that we can get S3 access and sample schema by EOD Monday?

If that all looks right I can kick off the onboarding tasks with Connor and Dev.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa
